actions.stoppingCue: Stop when you choose to keep this amount of color, or pause if the motion is uncomfortable.

actions.title: Brush on lip color
actions.instruction: Use your lip brush to apply your lip color with short strokes within your lips. Pause to look at the tint.
actions.detail: Follow your product and tool labels for preparation. Pause whenever you want to check the color or change the method.
actions.stoppingCue: Stop when you choose to keep the tint, or pause if the motion is uncomfortable.
